rule: If a future supervisor authorizes zeroing/masking of features or channels, that operation MUST be classified honestly as POST_HOC_PRE_OUTCOME_INPUT_OCCLUSION_OPERATIONALIZATION and MUST NOT be presented as equivalent to 'trained without feature/channel' unless separate training actually occurred.
note: No occlusion ruling is created by this audit. No ablation arm may be relabeled as a trained-architecture ablation.
